user.title: Name your controller
user.description: Connect one vehicle and its electricity price entities. The controller uses your existing Home Assistant integrations.

data_description.name: A label for this vehicle's charging controller.

vehicle.title: Vehicle and home location
vehicle.description: Choose the charging switch and feedback entities for this vehicle. Optional readings improve target and charging estimates.

data_description.charge_switch: The switch this integration may control. Only one controller can own a switch.
data_description.charging_sensor: Confirms whether the vehicle is actively charging; this is separate from the control switch state.
data_description.cable_sensor: Confirms that the vehicle is physically connected.
data_description.location_entity: Used to confirm that the vehicle is at home before controlling charging.
data_description.home_zone: Charging control is allowed only while the vehicle is in this zone.
data_description.soc_entity: A percentage from 0 to 100 used for planning and target checks.
data_description.car_limit_entity: Read only. Helps identify a vehicle limit that is below the requested target.
data_description.current_entity: Used to estimate charging power dynamically. If omitted, the configured fixed power is used.

electricity.title: Electricity prices and tariff
electricity.description: Select the current import rate and published rate events. The tariff attribute must identify the tariff currently served by the price entity.

data_description.rate_entity: The live import price used for immediate decisions.
data_description.today_rates_entity: Published price intervals for today, supplied by your electricity integration.
data_description.tomorrow_rates_entity: Published price intervals for tomorrow when available.
data_description.tariff_attribute: The attribute containing the active tariff name, commonly tariff.
data_description.tariff_match: Charging control is active only when the tariff value contains this text, case-insensitively. Other tariffs are handed back to your existing arrangement.
data_description.price_unit: Choose the unit reported by the current rate sensor. Prices are normalized internally for planning.
data_description.free_session_entity: A calendar whose confirmed event times represent free electricity sessions.

model.title: Optional measured charging power
model.description: Measured power can improve estimates after stable charging. The configured power model remains the fallback.

data_description.power_entity: A measured charging power sensor in kW. Preconditioning and short start-up transients are excluded from learning.

preconditioning.title: Preconditioning and completion feedback
preconditioning.description: The controller observes preconditioning and never schedules or operates vehicle climate control. Completion feedback is optional.

data.completion_state: State that means charging is complete

data_description.preconditioning_entity: Used to apply the preconditioning policy selected in options.
data_description.completion_entity: A sensor that reports a configured completion state.
data_description.completion_state: Expected completion state text, for example complete.

preferences.title: Initial charging preferences
preferences.description: These preferences are saved separately from entity connections and can be changed later in the integration options.

data.hard_price_ceiling: Enforce the maximum rate as a hard ceiling

data_description.mode: Cheap top-up follows the manual price limit; deadline mode plans toward one completion time; flexible mode maintains the target using available cheap periods.
data_description.max_cheap_rate: Manual maximum in p/kWh for cheap top-up and flexible charging.
data_description.target_percent: Requested battery percentage for planner modes. The car's own limit is never changed.
data_description.deadline: Used by deadline mode. Leave empty for the other modes.
data_description.hard_price_ceiling: When enabled, deadline planning will not select a rate above the manual maximum.
data_description.monitoring_only: Calculate and explain decisions without changing the charging switch.
data_description.automatic_control: Allow the integration to change the selected charging switch when its policy requires it.

error.required_entity: Select an entity for this required connection.
error.invalid_entity: The selected entity ID is invalid.
error.wrong_entity_domain: Choose an entity from the domain shown for this field.
error.entity_not_found: This entity no longer exists. Select an entity that is currently available in Home Assistant.
error.charge_switch_already_configured: Another EV Charge Controller already owns this charging switch. Each switch can have one controller.
error.required_text: Enter a value for this field.
error.deadline_required: Target by deadline mode needs a ready-by date and time.
error.invalid_deadline: Enter a valid date and time.

planning.title: Charging preferences
planning.description: Set the charging strategy, manual price limit, target and deadline policy.

data.hard_price_ceiling: Enforce the maximum rate as a hard ceiling

data_description.mode: Cheap top-up follows the manual price limit; deadline mode plans toward one completion time; flexible mode maintains the target using available cheap periods.
data_description.max_cheap_rate: Manual maximum in p/kWh for cheap top-up and flexible charging.
data_description.target_percent: Requested battery percentage. The car's own charge limit is never changed.
data_description.deadline: Used by deadline mode. Clearing this field removes the saved deadline.
data_description.hard_price_ceiling: When enabled, deadline planning will not select a rate above the manual maximum.

model.title: Charging model
model.description: These are planning assumptions. Measured current and stable measured power can refine the estimate.

data.learn_power: Learn charging power from stable sessions

data_description.capacity_kwh: Estimated usable battery capacity in kWh. The supplied starting assumption is 60 kWh.
data_description.voltage: Assumed voltage used with the charging current reading. The supplied starting assumption is 230 V.
data_description.efficiency: Estimated fraction of grid energy stored in the battery. The supplied starting assumption is 0.92.
data_description.fixed_power_kw: Used when no charging-current entity is selected.
data_description.learn_power: When enabled, use stable measured charging sessions to refine the power estimate. Preconditioning and short start-up transients are excluded; the configured model remains the fallback.
data_description.planning_margin: Extra time allowed for taper, delays and model uncertainty, expressed as a fraction from 0 to 0.5.
data_description.maintenance_margin: Flexible mode may resume charging when the battery falls this many percentage points below target.

preconditioning.title: Preconditioning policy
preconditioning.description: This integration observes your existing preconditioning automation. It does not operate climate control.

data_description.preconditioning_policy: Disabled adds no preconditioning exception; keep existing permits an already allowed charge to continue; allow permits charging while preconditioning is active.
data_description.preconditioning_minutes: An exception ends after this many minutes even if the sensor remains active. It can use grid power and may charge up to the car's own limit.

control.title: Control and overrides
control.description: Choose how the controller handles manual switch changes, monitoring and temporary boost sessions.

data_description.automatic_control: Allow the integration to change the selected charging switch when its policy requires it.
data_description.monitoring_only: Calculate and explain decisions without changing the charging switch.
data_description.boost_hours: Maximum boost duration. Boost still observes connection, home, tariff and vehicle safety checks.
data_description.external_change_policy: Respect stops the first unrequested charge start. A second start within 2 minutes, or switching charging off during a wanted charge, creates a temporary manual hold. Enforce resumes policy control after the acknowledgement window.
data_description.manual_hold_minutes: How long a detected manual change inhibits commands, unless resumed or unplugged sooner.

reliability.title: Retries and input freshness
reliability.description: Bounded retries handle delayed switch feedback. Freshness limits apply to vehicle readings that expose useful telemetry timestamps.

data_description.max_retries: Maximum retry attempts for an unconfirmed command.
data_description.retry_seconds: Base delay before retrying an unconfirmed command.
data_description.stale_minutes: Readings older than this are treated as stale when the source provides a freshness timestamp.

error.invalid_number: Enter a finite value within the allowed range.
error.deadline_required: Target by deadline mode needs a ready-by date and time.
error.invalid_deadline: Enter a valid date and time.

options.keep_existing: Keep an existing permitted charge running
